name: feat-1188-step1
title: #1188 step 1 — a vector with no position, drawn floating (3-D)

cases.title: «וקטור u» on an empty canvas draws a floating arrow that moves with «הציגו תצורה אחרת»
cases.lookFor: A single coloured (pink) arrow named u, underlined, with NO dot at its start and no point letters; each press of «הציגו תצורה אחרת» shows it with a different direction and length.
cases.before: Refused: «לא הבנתי את הבקשה…» — nothing drawn.

cases.title: Two declared vectors and a stated tuple: two arrows in two hues, the panel lists both
cases.lookFor: Two floating arrows, u and v, in two different colours (neither the teal of an anchored vector). Open the data panel: the stated rows read «v = (?, ?, ?)» and «u = (1, 2, 3)», and the measures show u = (1, 2, 3) with |u|.
cases.before: All three lines refused (the first two «לא הבנתי», the third «הווקטור «u» לא הוגדר»).

cases.title: A free vector floats BESIDE a cube, never at a vertex
cases.lookFor: The cube unchanged, and to its right a floating pink arrow u pointing up-and-away, not touching the cube and not starting at any lettered point.

cases.title: The textbook given «נתון: v = (10,-5,0)» builds on an empty canvas
cases.lookFor: Green row; one floating arrow v.

cases.title: REFUSAL — a magnitude on a free vector is the tool's limit, quoting the line
cases.lookFor: The second line is refused with «הכלי עדיין לא יודע לקבוע גודל … לווקטור החופשי u, ולכן «|u| = 5» לא נוסף — זו מגבלה של הכלי.»; the arrow u stays.
cases.before: Both refused; the second said «הווקטור «u» לא הוגדר» about the u just typed.

cases.title: REFUSAL — a sum of free vectors is the tool's limit (until step 2), quoting the line
cases.lookFor: u and v drawn; «w = u + v» refused with «הכלי עדיין לא יודע לחשב ביטוי שבו מופיע הווקטור החופשי u, ולכן «w = u + v» לא נוסף — זו מגבלה של הכלי.» — never «בדקו את החישוב».
cases.before: All refused; the third said «הווקטור «w» לא הוגדר».

cases.title: REFUSAL — one name, one meaning: a named edge vector cannot be re-declared free
cases.lookFor: The arrow AB named u stays green; «וקטור u» is refused «u» כבר מוגדר בציור…, and the FIRST row stays green.

cases.title: Ask «|u|» about a stated free vector
cases.lookFor: In the data panel's ask lane, «|u| = 5».
cases.before: «u = (3,0,4)» refused, so nothing to ask about.
